mapper.insert: INSERT INTO circle_member (circle_id, user_id, role, status, join_time) VALUES (#{circleId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT cm.*, u.nickname, u.avatar FROM circle_member cm LEFT JOIN user u ON cm.user_id = u.id WHERE cm.circle_id = #{circleId} ORDER BY cm.join_time ASC
SELECT * FROM circle_member WHERE circle_id = #{circleId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE circle_member SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circle_member WHERE circle_id = #{circleId} AND status = 1
SELECT * FROM circle_member WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
